dialogues.speaker: Kumi
dialogues.text: She's... still as reckless as ever...

dialogues.speaker: Kumi
dialogues.text: She doesn't seem to act like she's in a different nation at all. She just keeps going to strange and dangerous places every day...

dialogues.speaker: Kumi
dialogues.text: And once she gets into her studies, that's the whole day she'll be spending on research I can't make heads or tails out of...

dialogues.speaker: Kumi
dialogues.text: She honestly worries me a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Kumi
dialogues.text: But she's also very considerate, and her voice is quite lovely. I think I can bear with it, I guess...

dialogues.speaker: Kumi
dialogues.text: Um, don't misunderstand, please. She's a good person, so it's not as if I dislike her or something...
